name: _base.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-carousel/_base.scss — the .aw-c container — scroll track, WebGL arrow controls, dot/pill navigation, shared $awc-* sizing vars, and the action-appear keyframes.
//  Imported by awards-carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Dot diameter — inactive nav dots are small squares.
$awc-dot-size: to-rem($space-md);
/// Pill length — the active dot stretches to a rounded pill.
$awc-dot-pill: to-rem($space-xl);
/// Adjacent-slide bleed: how much of the neighbors peeks in on both sides.
$awc-peek: 10vw;

// ── Base container ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.aw-c {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 32px, 0);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;

  &.aw-c--in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }

  // ── Scroll track ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-track {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch; // equal height for all slides
    overflow-x: scroll;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &-slide {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;

    &--clone {
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }
  }

  // ── Controls ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-spacer {
    flex: 1;
  }

  // ── Dots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-dots {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);
    // Windowed: 1 active center + 2 partial each side
    max-width: calc(#{$awc-dot-pill} + #{$awc-dot-size} * 2 + #{to-rem($space-xs)} * 4);
    overflow: hidden;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  &-dot {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    // 8px visual dot lives in ::before; the button itself is a ≥24px pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8)
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    height: calc(#{$awc-dot-size} * 3);
    width: calc(#{$awc-dot-size} * 3);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;

    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
      translate: -50% -50%;
      height: $awc-dot-size;
      width: $awc-dot-size;
      border-radius: $awc-dot-size;
      background: var(--text-muted);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }

    &--active::before {
      width: $awc-dot-pill;
      background: var(--text-primary);
    }

    &:hover:not(&--active)::before,
    &:focus-visible:not(&--active)::before {
      background: var(--text-secondary);
    }
  }
}

// ── Action button delayed appearance ─────────────────────────────────────────
@keyframes action-appear {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
